Summary: Checks the policies of a CrowdStrike Falcon tenant: every enabled prevention policy blocks malware (cloud, Microsoft Office files and sensor anti-malware at Moderate or higher) and shows the Falcon icon, and every enabled sensor update policy keeps sensors at n-2 or newer with uninstall protection on. Reads only, through the PSFalcon module, on any Falcon cloud.

Prerequisites.Text: A Falcon API client (Support and resources > API clients and keys) with read scopes only: Prevention policies: Read and Sensor update policies: Read. A test whose scope is missing is skipped and says so.
Maester installs the PSFalcon module 2.2.9 from the PowerShell Gallery with the pack.

Steps.Text: Connect with the API client, on the cloud of your CID (us-1, us-2, eu-1, us-gov-1 or us-gov-2).
Steps.Command: Connect-Maester -Service WEY.FALCON.Api -ServiceSetting @{ ClientId = '<client id>'; ClientSecret = (Read-Host -AsSecureString 'Falcon client secret'); Cloud = 'eu-1' }

Steps.Text: A child CID in Flight Control (multi-CID): add its CID.
Steps.Command: Connect-Maester -Service WEY.FALCON.Api -ServiceSetting @{ ClientId = '<client id>'; ClientSecret = (Read-Host -AsSecureString 'Falcon client secret'); Cloud = 'us-1'; MemberCid = '<child CID>' }

Commands.Text: Run the pack on its own.

Options.Name: MinimumPreventionLevel
Options.Text: MP.WEY.FALCON.1001: the lowest prevention level of the anti-malware sliders (CAUTIOUS, MODERATE, AGGRESSIVE, EXTRA_AGGRESSIVE).

Options.Name: RequireFalconIcon
Options.Text: MP.WEY.FALCON.1001: also require Show Falcon icon to be on.

Options.Name: MaximumReleasesBehind
Options.Text: MP.WEY.FALCON.1002: how many releases the sensor version may be behind the latest (0 to 2).

AppOnly.Text: Runs unattended with MAESTER_WEY_FALCON_API_CLIENTID, MAESTER_WEY_FALCON_API_CLIENTSECRET and MAESTER_WEY_FALCON_API_CLOUD (and MAESTER_WEY_FALCON_API_MEMBERCID for a child CID). No Microsoft sign-in is needed.
